newsitem.title: USA: RealAmerica completes merger with Merrion.
newsitem.headline: RealAmerica completes merger with Merrion.

text.p: RealAmerica Co on Wednesday said it completed a merger agreement with Merrion Reinsurance Co Ltd of Dublin, Ireland.

Under terms of the transaction, the management and board of Merrion will assume control of RealAmerica, and Merrion will become a wholly owned subsidiary of Real America. RealAmerica plans to change its name to Merrion Reinsurance Co.
The Merrion stockholders will be issued 5.2 million shares of Class B common stock and 100,000 shares of a newly created Series A preferred for exchange of their shares in Merrion.
The Series A preferred shares will carry a $10 per share liquidation right and an annual dividend rate of $0.20 per share. Each preferred share is convertible into 402 shares of Class B common stock.
